name: Santa Piera no Heiwa na Sekai
original_name: サンタ・ピエラの平和な世界
source:
In a certain era.
In a certain country.

There lay a peaceful village.

While those outside the village suffered from war, famine, and plague,
the people of this village lived undisturbed, happy days.

It was a very, very peaceful village.
It was a very, very happy village.

[Translated from the [url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/blank-10]official site[/url]]
